import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

arr5 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0005.png').convert('RGB'))
arr12 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0012.png').convert('RGB'))

chair_mask5 = (arr5[:, :, 0] > 70) & (arr5[:, :, 0] < 160) & (arr5[:, :, 1] > 30) & (arr5[:, :, 1] < 90) & (arr5[:, :, 2] < 50) & (arr5[:, :, 0] > arr5[:, :, 1] + 20)
chair_mask12 = (arr12[:, :, 0] > 70) & (arr12[:, :, 0] < 160) & (arr12[:, :, 1] > 30) & (arr12[:, :, 1] < 90) & (arr12[:, :, 2] < 50) & (arr12[:, :, 0] > arr12[:, :, 1] + 20)

ys5, xs5 = np.where(chair_mask5)
ys12, xs12 = np.where(chair_mask12)

print('obs5 (y=0.0): x=[', xs5.min(), xs5.max(), '], y=[', ys5.min(), ys5.max(), ']')
print('obs12 (y=0.5): x=[', xs12.min(), xs12.max(), '], y=[', ys12.min(), ys12.max(), ']')

# In obs5: camera at (0, 0), facing -x
# In obs12: camera at (0, 0.5), facing -x
# That is a lateral shift of +0.5m (to the right of the camera)!
# If object is at (x_obj, y_obj):
# In obs5: X_c = y_obj, Y_c = -x_obj
# In obs12: X_c = y_obj - 0.5, Y_c = -x_obj
# Notice in obs12, the chair shifted to the left!
# Center x in obs5: (350 + 461) / 2 = 405.5
# Center x in obs12: (306 + 404) / 2 = 355.0
# Shift in pixels: 405.5 - 355.0 = 50.5 pixels
# Formula: Delta x_pix = f * Delta X_c / Y_c = 256 * 0.5 / Y_c
# Y_c = 256 * 0.5 / 50.5 = 2.53 m!
# And x_world = -Y_c = -2.53 m!
"
